title: Landing page for judges: choose the visual world
question: Re-rolled under the safer register for a judge-facing landing. Three familiar, legible directions plus the category standard. You pick.

options.label: 라이브 원장 · Live Ledger
options.lineage: Korean fintech ledger grammar (Toss, KakaoBank): large tabular numerals, hairline rows, one action color
options.thesis: The first viewport is the credit system running: one consultation plays out as a live ledger, hold → session → review → release, and the specialist's price multiplier updates in front of the judge.
options.viewport: Left: the one-line pitch in Korean with its English line directly beneath, and two equal actions (find a sunbae / become a sunbae). Right: a ledger card where a seeded consultation plays out in about ten seconds: 100 credits held, the session runs, a 92-point review posts, 95 released and 5 fee, and 박서준's rate ticks from 1.30× to 1.35× with its reason printed.
options.risk: Familiar: this is the Korean fintech default, and a judge may read banking app before mentoring unless the first line says consultation.

options.label: 명함 교환 · The Card Exchange
options.lineage: the two-handed 명함 (business card) exchange ritual
options.thesis: A specialist is a 명함 and booking is receiving the card; the first viewport is the exchange itself.
options.viewport: A specialist's card slides forward and flips to show 리뷰 12 · 평균 88 · 135 credits; a seeker's card answers from the other side. Each card carries its own action; the pitch line sits above in Korean with English beneath.
options.risk: Card heroes are common, the ritual reads East-Asia-specific to some judges, and the pricing mechanism only lives on the card back.

options.label: 시간표 · The Timetable
options.lineage: the campus timetable grid every Korean student keeps (에브리타임)
options.thesis: The availability grid is the hero: the judge watches a real slot get booked and credits move.
options.viewport: A week grid at object scale with a specialist's open slots; one slot highlights, a booking lands, credits are held, and the row beneath prints the price note. Pitch line and two actions sit above the grid.
options.risk: Reads as a calendar app first, is dense on mobile, and the campus reference is lost on judges.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The mentoring-marketplace landing as ADPList, Intro.co, and 코멘토 ship it: headline, search, mentor photo cards, how it works, trust row, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search over a row of mentor cards, three how-it-works steps, a trust row, a sign-up footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from ADPList and Intro by design, and it wants testimonials and logos the product does not have.
